findings.text: no test pins the budget constants, so the factor-of-ten defect this node repaired can be reintroduced without a single failing test.

the landing sentence says 'Largest arc vertex count meeting the tenth on the four rows ... weak 110 at 64 vertices', but 128 also meets the tenth for weak 110, so 64 is the smallest count and the sentence mislabels the column it reproduces.

the ninth column is smallest-met plus 128, so its values are 192 and 256 against a swept maximum of 128; the clause that the surviving rows 'land well inside the swept range' is false of that column and of the three smallest-met counts at 128, which sit at the sweep's edge rather than inside it.

failure_attribution states 'every gate exited 0 and no failure was observed', but the gate log it cites, .../reports/nova/s19-local/exact-closed-form/logs/gate-all_debug.log:424, records REREAD_EXIT=1 after an IndexError from a missing output argument, corrected only in the later job 1273502.

justifications.durability: No test references COUPLING_BUDGET, FALLBACK_BUDGET or benchmarks/exact_clip_closed_form_floor.py, so restoring the whole error term at benchmarks/exact_clip_closed_form_floor.py:216 would ship green with nothing failing.
justifications.evidence: Each done-when claim resolves to an artefact I reproduced rather than a claim - the constant block at benchmarks/exact_clip_closed_form_floor.py:216, the smallest-met counts recomputed from the nine receipts at docs/evidence/archive/exact-clip-moment-quadrature-landed.html:194, and the figure, whose regenerated PNG md5 db17a698c29cdd56e473a02d92072a34 equals the committed blob at docs/figures/exact-clip-closed-form/moment-convergence-and-budget.png.
justifications.fit: The repaired block at benchmarks/exact_clip_closed_form_floor.py:206-226 keeps the file's #: constant-with-rationale idiom, and the four commit bodies and the report script names carry nothing the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The landed change does what the goal states - benchmarks/exact_clip_closed_form_floor.py:216-226 holds the tenth on all nine rows - and the record at docs/evidence/archive/exact-clip-moment-quadrature-landed.html:194-205 and the plan landing at docs/plans/exact-clip-moment-quadrature.html:183 were independently recomputed and read back, with the five fallback rows honestly reported as met by no swept count.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff cf7c524e..1189360d names exactly the four declared write paths - benchmarks/exact_clip_closed_form_floor.py, docs/figures/exact-clip-closed-form/moment-convergence-and-budget.png, docs/evidence/archive/exact-clip-moment-quadrature-landed.html, docs/plans/exact-clip-moment-quadrature.html - and no other file.
